scientific_integrity: New contribution is explicit quantum-to-classical full-density separable mapping and its finite-population and sharp scaling consequences; classical mean-field saddle asymptotics and Gaussian decoupling are prior knowledge. Search-based priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Shared Brownian noise, noninteracting qubits, zero coherent Hamiltonian, Gaussian ensemble before normalization, gamma=1/(2N), initial product |+>, fixed-time thermodynamic limits; no claim of a previously unknown classical Curie--Weiss phase transition or generated entanglement.
title: Exact Curie--Weiss criticality from collective stochastic anti-Hermitian loss without entanglement
